acceptance_criteria: PASS: Safe directory and virtual package source/staging abstraction; no archive format is selected.
PASS: No permanent duplicate of the App Lifecycle manifest contract.
PASS: Public SDK manifest adapter validates and projects installer metadata.
PASS: Versioned deterministic installed-package inventory with relative locations.
PASS: Explicit read-only install and uninstall plans with stale-plan protection.
PASS: SemVer upgrade policy; downgrade and equal-precedence reinstall are rejected; malformed versions and unsupported schemas fail closed.
PASS: Durable transaction state machine rejects illegal transitions.
PASS: Atomic inventory replacement and immutable package promotion define the active-state switch.
PASS: Rollback restores the prior inventory and package after interrupted updates.
PASS: Deterministic crash/interruption recovery handles install and uninstall boundaries and orphan staging.
PASS: Safe uninstall deactivates inventory, preserves user data, and preserves unknown package-store content.
PASS: Path traversal, absolute paths, case/prefix conflicts, symlinks, and source escapes are rejected.
PASS: Structured installer errors expose stable error categories.
PASS: Capability-delta policy hook reports unchanged, added, and removed requirements without granting them.
PASS: SBOM, license, provenance, and trust checks have policy adapter hooks without taking ownership of their internals.
PASS: Failure injection covers staging, active switches, commit, and uninstall cleanup boundaries.
PASS: Offline deterministic transaction tests pass.
PASS: Installation, manifest, inventory, commit, recovery, uninstall, policy, and security boundaries are documented.
PASS: Dedicated workstream state is recorded using the DF-01 state schema shape.
PASS: Shared registry and root/CI integration proposals are recorded without editing Integration Owner paths.
PASS: Owned-scope format, warnings-denied Clippy, host check, Windows target check, and tests pass.
PASS: Implementation and documentation are committed on the dedicated branch; state/acceptance update is committed and pushed with remote HEAD verified.
